MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Gorilla tape felt especially relevant because I have bought that brand in two sizes, and durable waterproof tape fits the repair supplies I use.",
    "Waterproof crimp splices and adhesive-lined tubing would complement my existing electrical terminals by helping me join, insulate and seal wires."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The metric screw assortment and half-inch washers require specific size needs that my hose clamp purchases do not establish.",
    "Removable hook-and-loop fastening and electronic contact cleaning solve different problems from the repairs suggested by my tape and connector purchases.",
    "Several wiring products were relevant, but I would choose one connector kit and one adhesive-lined tubing kit rather than buy overlapping alternatives."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying repair supplies seems to have been treated as a reason to want assorted hardware, even when there is no evidence I need those particular sizes.",
    "My electrical terminal purchase seems to have prompted too many similar wiring supplies without enough attention to whether they add a distinct use."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated Gorilla tape purchases give a clearer reason to recommend another durable tape from that brand than a different kind of adhesive fastener.",
    "For the wiring supplies on this page, I prefer sealing and insulation that complement my existing terminals, with a smaller connector kit sufficient for my current choice.",
    "I need a concrete use for specialized hardware or cleaners; a general connection to repair work is not enough for me to choose them now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in practical repair supplies but stretched it too far into specialized hardware and overlapping wiring products."
}
